builds.title: Pooka ferryman’s acquaintance
builds.difficulty: Normal-monster tier, 0 XP. Descending Armor Class.
builds.speed: 120 ft./turn or 40 ft./round at up to 400 cn.
builds.senses: Second sight can recognize invisible or disguised fairies.
builds.languages: Fairy, local trade tongue and Chaotic. Communicates with animals.
traits: Fixed black hare form at this tier. No hands, armor or shield. Natural AC 7 improves to 6 from Dexterity 13. Hit Dice rolled 4 and 5.
Base THAC0 18 from 2 HD if needed. Saves as a 2nd-level thief. Death/poison 13, wands 14, paralysis/stone 13, breath 16, rod/staff/spell 15.
Immune to ghoul paralysis, natural disease and aging. A splash of holy water deals 1d4 damage.
actions: Selective invisibility at will. Choose who among mortals sees Brindlewake. Beings with second sight can recognize him.
Age an inanimate object at will by touch. Accelerate natural aging such as turning fresh cider sour or drying a wooden wedge. The referee decides the amount and local effect.
Send a dream to a sleeper. Save vs. spells to resist (use the target’s saving throw). The dream cannot deal damage or impose a condition at this tier.
builds.tactics: Appears to the person he trusts. Tries to say his piece before bolting. Given a chance, exposes the ferryman’s forged marker by aging the fresh paint on it.

builds.title: Warrior Sidhe sluice warden
builds.speed: 90 ft./turn or 30 ft./round, carrying 401–800 cn. Can breathe underwater.
builds.senses: Second sight can recognize invisible or disguised fairies.
builds.languages: Fairy, local trade tongue, Dryad, Elvish, Gnome, Treant and Neutral. Communicates with animals.
traits: First-level warrior totals 7 HP from the 0 XP d4 roll of 4 and the first-level d4 roll of 3. They count together as one Hit Die for attack.
Bronze chain mail AC 5 improves to AC 4 from Dexterity 13. No shield. Base THAC0 19. Strength 13 gives +1 to melee attack rolls and damage.
First-level fighter saves. Death/poison 12, wands 13, paralysis/stone 14, breath 15, rod/staff/spell 16.
Breathes water or air. Iron poisons through prolonged exposure. Iron weapon hits deal standard damage.
Immune to ghoul paralysis, natural disease and aging. A splash of holy water deals 1d4 damage.
actions: Bronze short sword. One attack at effective THAC0 18 for 1d6+1 damage. Roll the sharpening interval as 1d6+6 melee rounds. Once dull, it deals 1 point less until sharpened, minimum 1.
Detect Magic. One 1st-level fairy charm until replenished through communion with nature. For 2 turns, visible magic within 60 ft. of Ivara glows to them.
Invisibility to mortals at will. A creature Ivara attacks sees them. Second sight and Detect Invisible can reveal them.
builds.tactics: Volunteer information if someone shows concern for the people downstream. Step into the water for cover if threatened. Draw the bronze sword if someone tries to force the gate.

builds.title: Sprite orchard lookout
builds.speed: Land 60 ft./turn or 20 ft./round at up to 25 cn. Fly 180 ft./turn or 60 ft./round at up to 3 cn.
builds.senses: Second sight can recognize invisible or disguised fairies.
builds.languages: Fairy, local trade tongue, Elvish, Gnome, Halfling and Neutral. Communicates with animals.
traits: Natural AC 8 improves to AC 7 with Dexterity 13. Carries no weapon, armor or shield. Hit Dice rolled 2 and 3. Base THAC0 18 from 2 HD.
Second-level elf saves. Death/poison 12, wands 13, paralysis/stone 13, breath 15, rod/staff/spell 15.
If loaded above 3 cn, use the slower flying speed from Table 18a and rest for one turn after three turns of flight.
Immune to ghoul paralysis, natural disease and aging. A splash of holy water deals 1d4 damage.
actions: Invisibility to mortals at will. A creature Tansy attacks sees them. Second sight and Detect Invisible can reveal them.

Magic Missile. One 1st-level fairy charm until replenished by communion with nature. One missile automatically hits one visible target within 150 ft. for 1d6+1 damage. No saving throw. Use in its one-round duration.
Group curse. With four other sprites acting together, cast one harmless prank curse. A Remove Curse can undo it. Tansy cannot cast the curse alone.
builds.tactics: Watch from a high branch while invisible. If threatened, distract the intruder and fly away. Cast Magic Missile only to stop an immediate attack on someone else.

builds.title: Wood Imp trail watch, fighter path
builds.difficulty: Wood Imp 1, 800 XP. Descending Armor Class.
builds.speed: 90 ft./turn or 30 ft./round at up to 25 cn.
builds.languages: Wood Imp, local trade tongue and Chaotic. Communicates with spiders and other arachnids.
traits: No effective armor or shield. Unarmored AC 9 improves to 7 from Dexterity 16. Hit Dice rolled 2 and 3.
First-level fighter saves. Death/poison 12, wands 13, paralysis/stone 14, breath 15, rod/staff/spell 16.
In a forest, Nettle gains surprise on 1–3 on 1d6. Dexterity 16 gives +2 on ranged attack rolls.
actions: Miniature shortbow. Base THAC0 18. Effective THAC0 15/16/17 at short/medium/long range after Dexterity and range adjustments. On a hit, 1d4 damage. Range bands 50/100/150 ft. indoors or yards outdoors. Carries six unpoisoned arrows.
Call to a nearby spider in its own language. It can respond or decline according to its interests.
builds.tactics: Looks for trouble from the edge of woodland cover. If an enemy closes inside the bow’s effective range, retreat toward brush and watch for pursuit.

builds.title: Woodrake lock thief
builds.difficulty: Normal-monster tier, 0 XP. Descending Armor Class.
builds.speed: Drake land 120 ft./turn or 40 ft./round at up to 500 cn. Fly 30 ft./turn or 10 ft./round at up to 200 cn. Unarmored elf/halfling 120 ft./turn or 40 ft./round at up to 400 cn.
builds.senses: Second sight can recognize invisible or disguised fairies.
builds.languages: Fairy, local trade tongue, Elvish, Halfling and Chaotic. Communicates with animals.
skills: 5th-level thief skills. Open locks 35%, find traps 30%, remove traps 30%, climb walls 91%, move silently 40%, hide in shadows 28%, pick pockets 40%, hear noise 50%. Use the applicable form for the task.
traits: Natural drake AC 2 improves to AC 1 with Dexterity 13. Unarmored elf or halfling uses AC 8. Hit Dice rolled 4, 5, 4 and 5. Base THAC0 16.
8th-level magic-user saves from double Hit Dice. Death/poison 11, wands 12, paralysis/stone 11, breath 14, rod/staff/spell 12.
Use the book’s optional spell immunity. Announce before the round starts, up to two rounds per day. Ignore spells of 4th level or lower for that round.
Invisibility to mortals opens at 2nd level. Clove can still recognize other fairies with second sight.
Immune to ghoul paralysis, natural disease and aging. A splash of holy water deals 1d4 damage.
actions: Drake attack. Roll both claws and the bite separately at THAC0 16. Each claw deals 1d2 and the bite deals 1d8.
Shapechange at will between drake, elf, and halfling. Allow one round to change. Between forms, Clove’s dagger and lockpicks must be set down or picked up again.
Dagger in elf or halfling form. One melee attack at THAC0 16 for 1d4. If backstabbing a victim unaware of the approach, add +4 to hit and double the damage.
builds.tactics: Approach doors as a halfling locksmith. If surrounded in a confined room, use the drake shape once there is room and withdraw. Declare spell immunity when an opposing caster has a clear shot.

concepts.name: Brindlewake
concepts.speciesPublication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
concepts.motive: Protect a ferryman who once sheltered him from hounds.
concepts.hook: A passenger insists a black hare sat on the ferry rail and called the toll keeper by his childhood name.

concepts.name: Ivara Reedglass
concepts.speciesPublication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
concepts.motive: Keep the floodgate operational until the spawning run has passed.
concepts.hook: The iron gate key fell into the pool. The warden will guide a diver to it but asks someone else to carry it.

concepts.name: Tansy Duskwick
concepts.speciesPublication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
concepts.motive: Find who has been breaking the boughs after harvest.
concepts.hook: An unseen voice offers to show the party a snapped branch with a metal splinter in it.

concepts.name: Nettle Bracken
concepts.speciesPublication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
concepts.motive: Keep travelers from trampling a patch of spider egg sacs.
concepts.hook: Someone firing warning shots from the undergrowth is trying to turn a wagon away from a verge full of white silk.

concepts.name: Clove Barrow
concepts.speciesPublication: Tall Tales of the Wee Folk (PC1, 1989)
concepts.motive: Open an old vault simply to see whether its lock can be picked.
concepts.hook: A locksmith approaches with a delicate set of picks and asks the party who has the legal right to open the ruined tollhouse vault.
